verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding-agent CLI, and a product of this kind could plausibly ship an official SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents the CLI install (`npm i -g @randomlabs/slate`) and the TUI workflows, with no SDK or programmatic library. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no documented API surface to build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
